entries.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Para español, oprima el dos.
Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics.
Part of Pretty Good AI.
Am I speaking with James?
I'm not James. How can I help you today?
Thanks for letting me know.
Are you calling for information about the clinic, or is this about a specific patient?
I'm calling to request a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can help with that.
May I have the first name of the patient who needs the medication refill?
Sure, the first name is Robert.
May I have your first name, last name, and date of birth?
My name is Robert Williams, and my date of birth is January 8th, 1963.
I heard your birthday as January 8th.
Yes, that's correct.
Is that correct?
Could you spell your first and last name for me, please?
Certainly. My first name is Robert, R-O-B-E-R-T, and my last name is Williams, W-I-L-L-I-A-M-S.
What other phone number do we have on file for you?
The phone number on file is +1-555-033-1000.
I'm not able to find a patient record for Robert.
I can connect you to our patient support team for help with your medication refill.
Would you like me to transfer you now?
Yes, please. That would be helpful. Thank you.
Live transfer isn't available right now since this is a demo clinic.
In a real situation, I would have connected you to a support team member.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help! Goodbye!
You're welcome.
Have a great day!
Goodbye.
Goodbye! Have a great day!
